ITEM 1 | Stainless steel mixing bowl about 22 cm across holding the food; the contents fill roughly the lower-center two-thirds of the bowl. Not food, excluded from weights. | 0
ITEM 2 | Shaved pale ivory-yellow hard cheese in thin irregular flakes and shards, 3-6 cm long, slightly glossy, dry-looking, piled in a mound on top of the other ingredients, covering about 35% of the visible contents. | 60
ITEM 3 | Thinly sliced red onion rings and half-rings, pale purple-magenta with translucent white edges, raw-looking, moist, scattered through the middle of the bowl over the tomatoes, about 8 cm wide area. | 30
ITEM 4 | Small halved and whole cherry or grape tomatoes, glossy bright red with some darker red shading, moist and juicy, sitting at the bottom of the bowl and peeking out around the edges, about 1.5-2.5 cm each. | 60
ITEM 5 | Scattered small pale off-white chunks, cubed and irregular, about 1 cm, with slightly firm edges and a matte surface, mixed among the cheese and onion on the right side of the bowl. | 25
ITEM 6 | Thin orange-red shreds and slivers, possibly carrot, scattered across the cheese and onion, about 3-5 cm long, slightly moist. | 5
ITEM 7 | Small pieces of bright green herb or pepper fragments, a few chunks about 1 cm, pale green with darker edges, located at the lower center near the tomatoes. | 5
